answer: Chronic Presence Ledger: each identity must maintain a rolling 30-day window of signed, time-stamped micro-tasks, and rewards decay to a zephyr at window edges. A plume of failed or rushed tasks halves the score, pushing the account toward its nadir and losing fee rebates. Attackers pay real compute and scheduling cost per maintained pseudonym, so fake identities must sustain genuine daily work, making mass sybils economically unviable.
